title: Backward erasing pass
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions, let $s$ be an integer, and let $v$ be a Boolean stream word. For every Boolean word $w$, running the reset machine from its erasing control with the stream tape holding $v$ and its head at $s$, and the target tape holding $w$ with its head at $|w|-1$, for $|w|+1$ steps yields the configuration with the same input-head position and stream contents and head, the target tape blank with its head at zero, and the completed control.
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream, stream head, and target word $w$, running the reset machine in its erasing control at cell $|w| - 1$ for $|w| + 1$ steps erases every occupied target cell, including the first one, and returns the target head to zero in the completed control; the stream is neither read nor modified.
